facts: Mobileye announced scheduled participation in Evercore's 9th Annual ADAS, AV & AI Forum on September 29, 2026.
The company said it plans to webcast fireside chats when possible and direct investors to its Events & Presentations page for exact timing and access.
The announcement explicitly states that event participation and dates are subject to change.

factors.name: catalystScore
factors.basis: A near-dated ADAS/AV/AI investor forum creates a concrete information-update window on September 29, but the issuer has not promised a product, financial or commercial announcement and participation remains subject to change.

factors.name: executionMonitoring
factors.basis: The event offers a near-term opportunity to test management commentary against existing ADAS, robotaxi and physical-AI execution claims; attendance itself is not evidence of execution progress.

risks.risk: Treating a scheduled investor appearance as a substantive catalyst would overstate the evidence because no new operating disclosure is promised and the event may change.

contradictions: The scheduled forum is a real near-term information event, but it does not by itself validate pipeline conversion, margin progress, robotaxi commercialization or Mentee execution.
unknowns: Whether Mobileye will webcast the September 29 fireside chat.
Whether management will disclose materially new financial, commercial or technical information at the event.
